items.titleEn: ‘For the first time I have my own chair’: Gaza siblings find new freedom
items.titleZh: “我第一次有了自己的椅子”：加沙三兄妹迎来新的生活
items.summaryEn: In Gaza, 10-year-old Anas is one of three siblings born without legs and with only two fingers on each of their hands. They struggle to move around and perform daily activities like eating and writing independently.
items.summaryZh: 在加沙， 10岁的阿纳斯是出生时没有腿的三个兄弟姐妹之一，每只手上只有两根手指。他们很难四处走动，也很难独立地进行饮食和写作等日常活动。

items.titleEn: ‘No Escape’ for refugees on the frontlines of the climate crisis
items.titleZh: 气候危机前线的难民“无处可逃”
items.summaryEn: The climate emergency is an immediate crisis for refugees, with three in four – nearly 90 million people – living in countries facing high to severe exposure to hazards such as drought, floods and extreme heat.
items.summaryZh: 气候紧急情况对难民来说是一个紧迫的危机，四分之三（近9000万人）生活在面临严重干旱、洪水和极端高温等危险的国家。

items.titleEn: Sudan’s suffering is plain for all to see say aid teams, as brutal war continues
items.titleZh: 援助团队：苏丹战火持续，民众苦难有目共睹
items.summaryEn: Aid teams working to help millions of people uprooted by the ongoing war in Sudan appealed on Friday for more international assistance amid desperate funding shortages, empty warehouses and overwhelming needs.
items.summaryZh: 在资金严重短缺、仓库空置和需求巨大的情况下，致力于帮助因苏丹战争而背井离乡的数百万人的援助团队周五呼吁提供更多的国际援助。

items.titleEn: From a ship frozen into Arctic ice, a warning to world leaders: Trust the science
items.titleZh: 从一艘冻结在北极冰中的船上，向世界各国领导人发出警告：相信科学
items.summaryEn: Drifting through the polar darkness, a team of scientists is documenting a rapidly changing Arctic. As sea ice retreats and oil tankers move in, a conversation with the UN chief reveals why the battle for climate science matters far beyond…
items.summaryZh: 在极地黑暗中漂流，一组科学家正在记录迅速变化的北极。随着海冰撤退和油轮驶入，与联合国负责人的对话揭示了为什么气候科学的斗争远远超出了……

items.titleEn: World News in Brief: Civilians killed in DR Congo, Ukrainians wrestle with return, Guterres calls out ‘normalisation’ of force
items.titleZh: 世界新闻简报：刚果（金）平民遇害、乌克兰民众返乡艰难、古特雷斯批评武力“正常化”
items.summaryEn: At least 30 civilians were killed overnight on Thursday in Beni Territory, North Kivu in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to local sources cited by the UN aid coordination office (OCHA).
items.summaryZh: 据联合国援助协调办公室（ OCHA ）援引的当地消息来源称，周四晚上在刚果民主共和国北基伍省贝尼地区至少有30名平民被杀。

items.titleEn: Afghanistan faces deepening humanitarian crisis amid sweeping rights restrictions
items.titleZh: 阿富汗人道主义危机加深，权利限制全面收紧
items.summaryEn: Afghanistan stands at a “difficult crossroad” more than five years after the Taliban returned to power, a senior UN official said on Friday. Relative stability and security are being undercut by a fragile economy, sweeping curbs on rights a…
items.summaryZh: 一名联合国高级官员周五表示，在塔利班重新掌权五年多后，阿富汗正处于“艰难的十字路口”。相对稳定和安全正受到脆弱经济的削弱，权利受到全面限制……

items.titleEn: Two new Ebola vaccines to join DR Congo clinical trial
items.titleZh: 两种新型埃博拉疫苗进入刚果（金）临床试验
items.summaryEn: Two new Ebola vaccine candidates will be added to a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as the country continues to battle a deadly outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo species of the virus.
items.summaryZh: 两种新的埃博拉候选疫苗将被添加到刚果民主共和国的临床试验中，因为该国将继续与Bundibugyo种病毒引起的致命疫情作斗争。

items.titleEn: Children at risk as war zone attacks on water and sanitation more than triple
items.titleZh: 水与卫生设施屡遭袭击，冲突地区儿童面临的风险增至三倍
items.summaryEn: Attacks that damaged or destroyed water and sanitation systems in conflict zones tripled between 2021 and 2025, increasing children’s risk of exposure to disease outbreaks, malnutrition and violence.
items.summaryZh: 在2021年至2025年期间，破坏或摧毁冲突地区供水和卫生系统的袭击增加了两倍，增加了儿童暴露于疾病爆发、营养不良和暴力的风险。

items.titleEn: Abyei: Deadly drone strikes mark ‘new and concerning’ threat, UN peacekeeping chief warns
items.titleZh: 阿卜耶伊：联合国维和行动负责人警告称，致命的无人机袭击标志着“新的和令人担忧的”威胁
items.summaryEn: Drone strikes that killed at least 30 people in Abyei last month have added “a new and concerning dimension” to security in the disputed area, the UN’s peacekeeping chief told the Security Council on Thursday.
items.summaryZh: 联合国维和行动负责人周四告诉安理会，上个月在阿卜耶伊造成至少30人死亡的无人机袭击为争议地区的安全增加了“一个新的和令人担忧的层面”。

items.titleEn: World News in Brief: Korea tensions mount, UN demands answers over staff death in Yemen, Guterres in Spain, Nepal alert ahead of COP31
items.titleZh: 世界新闻简报：朝鲜半岛局势升温、联合国要求彻查也门工作人员死亡事件、尼泊尔在COP31前发出警报
items.summaryEn: UN Secretary-General António Guterres remains concerned over the situation on the Korean Peninsula, including the potential escalation of tensions across the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), his Spokesperson said on Thursday.
items.summaryZh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯（ António Guterres ）的发言人周四表示，他仍然对朝鲜半岛的局势感到担忧，包括整个非军事区（ DMZ ）的紧张局势可能升级。

items.source: IFRC GO 国际红十字与红新月联合会

items.titleEn: ‘The world is not ready’: Climate adaptation cash falls far short as warming heads past 1.5°C
items.titleZh: “世界尚未准备好”：气候适应资金严重不足，升温即将突破1.5℃
items.summaryEn: Although global warming is set to exceed 1.5°C, financing to help communities adapt to climate change falls far short of needs, the UN Environment Programme (UNEP) said in a report published on Wednesday.
items.summaryZh: 联合国环境规划署（ UNEP ）在周三发布的一份报告中表示，尽管全球变暖将超过1.5°C ，但帮助社区适应气候变化的资金远远不足以满足需求。

items.titleEn: Afghan children face narrowing path to education, UN agencies report
items.titleZh: 联合国机构报告：阿富汗儿童受教育的途径日益狭窄
items.summaryEn: More than half of Afghanistan’s children who should be in primary school remain outside formal learning and millions of girls can only dream of going to university.
items.summaryZh: 应该上小学的阿富汗儿童中有一半以上仍未接受正规教育，数百万女孩只能梦想上大学。

items.titleEn: 15 years of ‘almost no progress’ in getting young people moving: WHO
items.titleZh: 15年来，在让年轻人流动方面“几乎没有进展” ：世界卫生组织
items.summaryEn: One in four adolescents worldwide reported not getting at least 60 minutes of physical activity on any day in the previous week, according to new global estimates released by the World Health Organization (WHO) on Wednesday.
items.summaryZh: 根据世界卫生组织（ WHO ）周三发布的最新全球估计，全球四分之一的青少年报告说，前一周的任何一天都没有至少60分钟的身体活动。

items.titleEn: Syria’s undocumented children ‘pay the price’ of war and a law that shuts out mothers
items.titleZh: 叙利亚无证儿童为战争和一项将母亲拒之门外的法律“付出代价”
items.summaryEn: Many children born in Syria since the war began in 2011 have no legal identity because nationality passes only through fathers – many of whom are dead or missing – a member of the independent UN commission investigating rights violations in…
items.summaryZh: 自2011年战争开始以来，许多在叙利亚出生的儿童没有合法身份，因为国籍只通过父亲传递--其中许多人已经死亡或失踪--是联合国独立委员会的成员，负责调查……侵犯人权的行为

items.titleEn: Fuel price shock: Why developing economies are paying the most at the pump
items.titleZh: 燃油价格冲击：为什么发展中经济体在油价上付出最大的代价
items.summaryEn: When war shut the Strait of Hormuz in February, oil prices soared everywhere. But the pain at the pump has been far from equal, and the world’s developing economies are paying the heaviest price, according to a new report from UNCTAD…
items.summaryZh: 当战争在2月份关闭霍尔木兹海峡时，油价在各地飙升。但根据贸发会议的一份新报告，泵的痛苦远未达到平等，世界上的发展中经济体正在付出最沉重的代价……

items.titleEn: Gunfire damages tents at Rafah displacement site in Gaza, as aid teams prepare for winter storms
items.titleZh: 在救援队为冬季风暴做准备之际，枪声摧毁了加沙拉法流离失所者营地的帐篷
items.summaryEn: Gunfire hit and damaged multiple tents at a displacement site in Gaza’s northern Rafah region on Tuesday, reportedly causing injuries and forcing a humanitarian partner to leave the area, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) has said.
items.summaryZh: 联合国援助协调办公室（ OCHA ）表示，周二，在加沙北部拉法地区的一个流离失所地点，枪声击中并损坏了多个帐篷，据称造成人员受伤，并迫使人道主义合作伙伴离开该地区。

items.titleEn: UN peacekeeping chief warns of ‘security vacuum’ as Blue Helmets leave Lebanon and Western Sahara
items.titleZh: 联合国维和负责人警告“安全真空”：蓝盔部队将撤出黎巴嫩与西撒哈拉
items.summaryEn: The UN’s peacekeeping chief warned on Wednesday that the withdrawal of “Blue Helmets” from Lebanon and Western Sahara risks leaving a dangerous security vacuum, while the Security Council remains divided over what, if anything, should repla…
items.summaryZh: 联合国维和行动负责人周三警告说，从黎巴嫩和西撒哈拉撤出“蓝盔部队”可能会留下危险的安全真空，而安理会在应该补充什么（如果有的话）的问题上仍然存在分歧。

items.titleEn: COP31 explained: What’s at stake at this year’s UN climate summit?
items.titleZh: 解读COP31：今年的联合国气候峰会有哪些看点
items.summaryEn: The world has more tools than ever to tackle climate change, yet millions remain unable to benefit from them. As clean energy technologies advance faster than ever, the challenge facing countries at COP31 is no longer just finding solutions…
items.summaryZh: 世界上应对气候变化的工具比以往任何时候都多，但仍有数百万人无法从中受益。随着清洁能源技术比以往任何时候都更快地发展，各国在COP31上面临的挑战不再仅仅是寻找解决方案……

items.titleEn: Gender equality pays off for business – so why are companies pulling back?
items.titleZh: 性别平等能为企业带来回报，为何一些企业却在退缩？
items.summaryEn: Gender equality and diversity are good for business – but while increasing numbers of women are reaching top spots in the corporate world, more initiatives are needed to keep momentum going.
items.summaryZh: 性别平等和多样性对企业有利，但随着越来越多的女性进入企业界的榜首，需要采取更多举措来保持势头。

items.titleEn: Married off at 14: In Yemen’s war, women and girls suffer ‘devastating consequences’
items.titleZh: 14岁被迫出嫁：也门战火中妇女和女童承受“毁灭性后果”
items.summaryEn: Safa is 14. Her mother died earlier this year. She has no brothers or sisters. And a few weeks ago, as the crisis took hold, her father married her to an elderly man, afraid that if he were killed in the hostilities, no one would be left to…
items.summaryZh: 萨法14岁。她母亲今年早些时候去世了。她没有兄弟姐妹。几周前，随着危机的蔓延，她的父亲将她嫁给了一位老人，担心如果他在敌对行动中被杀，没有人会被留下……

items.titleEn: World News in Brief: Children killed in Myanmar strike, new violence flares in Mozambique, an Internet affordability milestone
items.titleZh: 世界新闻简报：缅甸空袭致儿童死亡、莫桑比克暴力再起、全球互联网可负担性迎来里程碑
items.summaryEn: A school in Myanmar has been hit in an airstrike, with three children reported killed and five others injured, according to UN Children’s Fund UNICEF.
items.summaryZh: 根据联合国儿童基金会（ UNICEF ）的数据，缅甸的一所学校在空袭中被击中，据报有3名儿童死亡，另有5人受伤。

items.titleEn: ‘This is not about politics. This is about people’: UN warns of impact of deadly drone strikes in Sudan
items.titleZh: “这不是政治问题，而是人的问题”：联合国警告苏丹无人机袭击后果
items.summaryEn: Intensifying drone attacks on civilian infrastructure across Sudan are disrupting electricity, water and fuel supplies, putting lives at risk and hampering the delivery of humanitarian aid, the UN’s top official in the country has warned.&n…
items.summaryZh: 联合国驻苏丹高级官员警告说，无人机对苏丹各地民用基础设施的袭击正在加剧，扰乱电力、水和燃料供应，危及生命，阻碍人道主义援助的运送。
